svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 01 OF 10 • DOMAIN: PLACE VALUE & 5-ANCHOR SUBITIZING • 7.00mm 1U PITCH • 10-FRAME STACKING SLOTS
Step-by-Step Hands-On Tutorial: 8 + 5 = 13 via Bridging to 10
Grades K–3 Subitizing & Place Value • Hands-On Classroom & Home STEM Studio Series

text.tspan: How many empty spots are left in Frame
A before you start moving counters
Place 8 blue counters in Ten-Frame A.
Fill the top row (5 blue) and bottom row (3 blue).
Notice: exactly 2 slots remain empty to complete the ten.
Place 5 red counters in Ten-Frame B (fills top row of 5).
We want to calculate 8 + 5 without counting by ones.
Frame A needs 2 counters to bridge to 10.
3. BRIDGE TO 10: Move 2 red counters from B to A. Frame A is now 1 Ten (10)!
4. READ REMAINING ONES: Frame B has 3 red counters left. Total: 10 + 3 = 13!

g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: ADDITION IS BRIDGING, NOT COUNTING

text.tspan: Counting on fingers by ones is slow and error-prone. The 10-frame proves that addition is
Once students see the 2 empty spaces in the 8-frame, they instantly know to borrow 2 from the 5!
Put 7 in Frame A (3 empty). Put 6 in Frame B. Move 3 to make a ten. How many are left in B? 10
